question: N51的NVFP4量化对T_memory的影响系数：KV Cache从FP16(2 bytes/token/head)降至FP8/INT8(1 byte/token/head)使访存量减半，但V100不支持原生FP4推理，实际部署若回退至FP8，T_memory减半的前提是否成立需验证vLLM在V100上的量化内核支持情况

sources.title: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for ...
sources.snippet: 1NVIDIA Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4.
